book.name: 2 Kolin
book.title: Fut kale Fol em Auk Teben Fut Kolin Abiw Mutuk Fian em Sios Kawtiw ilo Dabalayemse Fut kale.

content: Sunbin-Got e Akalem Weng e Baluw Kunum im Teing Dim elo Dase em Sang te.
Nakunum kumel kunum waneng yutaka! Sunbin-Got e nulo kinkin keyemeko, kitakamin weng kikis beem aluwbamin duyemse kasike, nu nam beit keko, kolewuw kate,

nu kitil kuw moko, wa kukuw so, inkal duyemin kukuw so, alik alik be ibiku koyemkabuluw te. Ibiku koyemsomi, mali kawtiw ilo funum funum keyemsomi, Sunbin-Got em weng fein be alwol kelewko, nanew kelewinba kekabuluw te. Kate, nu kaim dim fein weng kuw bakayem bakayem kekabuluw te. Kebuluwi, kunum waneng alik alik ikalem ibolow tem kel Sunbin-Got eso ibolow ki makmak keko, num kanebuluw be diw atebamoliwka!
Keko beli, num weng bakabuluw weng be mali kawtiw kuankemin em deiw kakabiliw ite kuw kiliko, kilele ateminba kekabiliw te.

Nimtew angom? Kawin dim kaleem got Seten-Ataanim e fein ibolow kelinba kebiliw kawtiw im ibolow fukunin be aimge koyemse angomi, i ki keko, Sunbin-Got em takak kebe Kulais em Weng Kal Ken Ati kaleem auk so kitil so ailbin fian beelo kilele ateminba kebiliw kasike.

Yu kililina! Nu nukalem sang ete bakayeminba kekabuluw kate, nu sang fian “Kulais e Kamok Fian te!”, ange ange keko, bakayemkakawkabuluw te. Bakayembuluw kate, nukalem sang gel e kanekote: Yesus e nulo yom weng afak kunum keyemse te.

Keko beli, Sunbin-Got e sua e bokolomele: “Mililiw be ‘Felet mak angoka!’”, angse Sunbin-Got be num ibolow mutuk kel akalem auk so kitil so Yesus Kulais em kiinguen ailbe ailbin filik so bakati num ibolow dolon keyemkabe te.

Kate, nu on kisol fian emdiw eisneng be kawtolomin ok sen dim kel atew keko, aluwkabuluw kasike, kawtiw alik alik i kilele atemiwete: Nukalem kitil fong gel em dim ba kate, “Sunbin-Got em kitil auk so fian ete kuw kaneliw kai!”, angakabiliw te.
Feinka! Nu kal ilum fian banban kulukabuluw kate, ilum be nulo nam kawtol koyeme te. Nu teifuluko, ibolow fukunin alew so buluw kate, num ibolow mutuk miyak so nam dakulu yeme te.
Mali kawtiw i nulo yenomin keko, yenkabiliw kate, Sunbin-Got e nulo koyeminbakabe kasike, nu nam kuanuw te.

Diwkuw diwkuw nu kal ilum kuluko, Yesus em kuanse sang bakayem tem bakayem tem kakabomi, nukal kuanomin kis kebuluw kasike, beem mongom ete Yesus beem finik so duyemin sang akati bakayem tem bakayem tem kakabuluw te.

Kakabuluwi, mali kawtiw i nulo yenomin deiw feneko, Yesus em finik so buluw kunum waneng nulo “Yulo yenuwi, yu kuanina!”, yangbiliw kasike, nukalem kuanomin kis kebe kal dim beem dim kel e Yesus em finik so bin duyembe be fein fitewoke te.

Keko kasike, aso num aluwbamin beem mongom ete kuankemin e nukalem kal dim kel ambet keyembe te. Kate, aso num aluwbamin beem mongom ete finik so kulamin e yukalem mutuk dim kel kitil kuw aluwkabe te.

Num fein ibolow e Sunbin-Got em fut bose kunum beem fein ibolow emdiw kekabe te. E fut tem kel bolomele: “Ne Sunbin-Got elo ‘Fein!’, dangbi kasike, em weng bakayemkabi te!”, angse kasike, nukati bakatetew keko, em weng bakayem kakawkabuluw te.
Nimtew angom? Nu kilele kal keluwete: Sunbin-Got e Kamok Fian Yesus elo dawkalfolse beemdiw nukati eso yemkalfoleko, nuso yuso bongguko, em mit mewso mo koyemoke kasike.

Feinka! Alik alik kanebe be yom gomet ete keyemkabe te. Keyembelei, Sunbin-Got em ibolow folok e kunum waneng banban dokoyemei, i tulun kuw keko, im Sunbin-Got elo “Weso! Seyo!”, angakabiliw weng bakati fian kuw kesomelei, Sunbin-Got e wiin fian mak kulabe te.
Sow em Wiin so Kemokoluw em Sang te.

Nakunum kumel kunum waneng yutaka! Num kal anggil be diwkuw walomin kebe kate, Sunbin-Got e num mutuk tem be diwkuw diwkuw kikis kelewkabe te. Beem mongom ete nu gatak wakmininba keko, melmel senko, kakabuluw te.

Nimtew angom? Num kaleem ding em kal ilum gel be sukum ding kuw nulo kal ilum yemkatikoko, koyembe kate, sow ete, num abiil tikin bokoluw ding kabalak e, kal ilum beem aluwbamin beem mongom ete nu banimominba wiin atin kuw fian mak kulokoluw kasike.

Keko beli, nu kawin dim kaleem kiin so atebuluw beem eisneng elo atemeko, ibolow dulewinba kekabuluw kate, nu kiin so ateminba eisneng beem ibolow kuw duleweko, kiin sonolewkabuluw te. Nimtew angom? Kiin so atebuluw eisneng be banimoke kate, kiin so ateminba eisneng be sunsun kuw boke kasike.
